pull.q: This complex matrix oscillator from Pittsburgh Modular does things that'll make other oscillator modules jealous.

quotes.t: This is a 2-oscillator module that is so powerful it's almost a synth voice on its own. In essence, Double Helix is a modular waveform generator.

The core of the Double Helix is based on the low pass gate of the original Buchla circuitry, but Pittsburgh Modular have re-engineered the secret additional ingredient, a vactrol, for a completely analog design that allows for very short decays or very long decays when you want them.

blurb.en: Complex dual-VCO voice: the primary oscillator puts out sine, saw, Pittsburgh's folded 'blade' wave and a sub, while the second oscillator FMs it or runs on its own. A wavefolder and dynamic low-pass gate shape the contour, with an LFO/noise modulation section and two voltage-controlled routers patching the whole thing together.
blurb.fi: Kaksois-VCO: pääoskillaattori antaa siniä, sahaa, Pittsburghin taitetun 'blade'-aallon ja subin, kun taas toinen oskillaattori FM:ää sitä tai pyörii omillaan. Wavefolder ja dynaaminen low-pass gate muovaavat konttuuria, mukana LFO/noise-modulaatio-osio ja kaksi jänniteohjattua reititintä.
blurb.sv: Dubbel-VCO: primäroscillatorn ger sinus, sågtand, Pittsburghs vikta 'blade'-våg och en sub, medan den andra oscillatorn FM:ar den eller går för sig själv. En wavefolder och en dynamisk low-pass gate formar konturen, med en LFO/brus-modulationsdel och två spänningsstyrda routrar.
